config.name: stage4_Y_homogeneous_water

bubble_response.provenance: Demo assumptions; not calibrated SonoVue shell parameters

config.experiment_scope: Stage4 finite initial ensemble, homogeneous water, geometric walls; no clinical concentration or patient calibration

effective_acoustic_field.scope: Loaded field is authoritative for interpolation; base grid config identifies the original basis. Overrides retain their own field grid and direct-solver metadata.

saved_constrained_slip_Re.scope: Saved active states, not all accepted steps; inactive NaNs are intentional.

rejected_steps.scope: No error-estimator rejection/retry loop in this implementation; failures would abort, not silently retry.

effective_dt.scope: Only 301 visualization frames stored. Small macro-boundary remainder steps can determine the recorded minimum.

geometry_query_counters.method: Exact repeated coordinates only; no quantization or field approximation

pair_force_calls.scope: Each successful evaluate call records one validity check and one secondary-force call; not a separately instrumented counter.

response_context.shell_parameters: Fixed table parameter manifold; other shell parameters require another table

validity.note: Sample fraction includes RK stages; time fraction uses accepted interval endpoint flags. Passing policies is not experimental validation

worker_process_cpu.scope: Process-lifetime /proc sample at completed-case boundary; includes initialization and negligible pool cleanup.

peak_RAM.scope: Linux process high-water mark observed after scientific completion, before natural worker exit.

sampled_VRAM.scope: Device-wide nvidia-smi samples; not a per-case lifetime maximum or a GPU-time measurement.
